partnershipPlan: A patient partner from the regional advisory council and two family doctors join the A3 team; practice managers comment on the template wording before release.
socialListening: No social media listening; complaints to the intake about returned referrals over the last year are read and themed.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My doctor said she had referred me, and three weeks later I found out it had been sent back.
items.implication: Make the status of returned referrals visible to practices and tell patients when a referral is returned.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every required field is a minute I do not have between patients.
items.implication: Keep required fields to what triage needs and time template completion.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half my morning is phoning practices for a blood result that is already in their system.
items.implication: Pull results automatically where possible and remove chasing from nurse work.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We are an hour from the lab; a required result means a week's delay for our patients.
items.implication: Keep the documented exception and report returned referrals by practice group.

summary: Four composite voices on invisible returns, practice workload, chasing and access to tests.
